[Skip to content](https://coefficient.io/top-data-enrichment-apis#primary) Last Modified: September 29, 2025 - 23 min read Nikesh Vora Join our community [![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/yt-icon.svg)](https://www.youtube.com/@coefficientio "YouTube")[![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/twitter-icon.svg)](https://twitter.com/coefficient_io "Twitter")[![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/fb-icon.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/Coefficient.io "Facebook")[![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/linkedin-icon.svg)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/coefficientworks "LinkedIn") Missing data kills deals. Your CRM has gaps. Your emails bounce. Your calls go nowhere. **Data enrichment APIs** fix this by filling in the blanks automatically—turning partial contacts into complete profiles ready for outreach. Let’s explore the best free and paid **data enrichment APIs** that transform incomplete data into actionable intelligence. ## **Feature Comparison Table** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link | | | | | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Tool** | **Pricing Model** | **Data Coverage** | **API Rate Limits** | **Key Data Points** | **Compliance** | **Best For** | | **Hunter.io** | Free: 50/mo

Coefficient eliminates the need to export data manually and rebuild stale dashboards. Get started by pulling live data into pre-built Sheets dashboards.](https://coefficient.io/get-started?ref=blog) ## [**Hunter.io**](http://hunter.io/) ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Hunter.io turns company domains into verified email addresses, making it simple for sales teams to find and reach decision-makers. The platform combines email discovery with verification and campaign tools, creating a complete outreach solution that works directly from your browser or API. ### **Highlights of Hunter.io** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Database with strong North American and European coverage - Chrome extension for instant LinkedIn email discovery - All-in-one platform with email campaigns and CRM features - Bulk processing for large domain lists ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Simple to start:** The interface needs zero training. Your team can find emails immediately without watching tutorials or reading guides. - **Complete outreach toolkit:** Beyond finding emails, Hunter.io manages campaigns, verifies addresses, and runs automated sequences. One tool replaces three or four separate subscriptions. - **Strong integrations:** The API connects with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive. Zapier support means you can automate workflows without coding. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Accuracy dropping:** Email finding accuracy fell to 65-75% this year. That’s a 12% decline. Your cost per verified lead now exceeds $3-5. - **Weak international data:** Coverage drops hard outside North America and Western Europe. Asian and African markets show particularly poor accuracy rates. - **Pricey for small teams:** The free plan’s 50 monthly searches disappear fast. Paid plans start at $49/month, which hurts small businesses needing volume. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Hunter.io offers a free plan with 50 searches monthly. Paid plans: Starter at $49/month (monthly) or $34/month (annual), Growth at $149/month or $104/month annually, and Business at $499/month or $349/month annually. ### **What do users say about Hunter.io?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “Hunter is cost-effective, makes it incredibly easy to automate cold-email campaigns and is simply so easy to use. I never have to train my team on Hunter, and they already have so much material on how to use it well anyway! It has incredible integrations and the team are always actively developing and extending the platform.” **Critical Review:** “Before hunter looking for emails and industry-insights was incredibly manual and time consuming, hunter has sped up our market research significantly. However, it would be great to have something like a JetPack CRM or Suite CRM plugin, but naturally we can use the API for this anyhow.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Hunter.io provides email support at contact@hunter.io, plus a Help Center with 92+ FAQ articles. Higher-tier plans get priority support. The team focuses on fast responses, empathy, and detailed answers through weekly success meetings and pair-support sessions. ## [**Apollo.io**](http://apollo.io/) ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Apollo.io merges prospecting, outreach, and CRM into one platform that handles your entire sales process. With access to millions of B2B contacts and built-in engagement tools, it eliminates the need for multiple sales tools while providing everything from lead generation to deal closing. ### **Highlights of Apollo.io** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Most-reviewed G2 product with 8,800+ reviews and 4.7/5 rating - 183 No. 1 rankings in G2’s Summer 2025 Report - Lead generation, CRM, email sequences, and phone dialer combined - Chrome extension for LinkedIn prospecting ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Everything in one place:** Apollo combines lead capture, CRM, email sequences, and sales intelligence. No more juggling multiple tools. Your software costs drop immediately. - **Massive database:** The platform maintains extensive contact and company data. Small to medium businesses get particularly good coverage, plus real-time enrichment. - **Users love it:** With 183 #1 rankings on G2, Apollo proves its value daily. User satisfaction stays consistently high across thousands of reviews. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Credit math confusion:** Different actions eat different credit amounts. Eight credits for a phone number. Multiple credits for enrichment. Predicting monthly costs becomes impossible. - **Free plan gutted:** New accounts get 100 monthly email credits. Legacy accounts still receive 10,000. The free tier lost most of its value. - **Interface overload:** Users call it “tough to figure out.” The platform packs so many features that new users struggle to find value initially. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Apollo offers: Free plan with 100 credits monthly, Basic at $49/month per user (annual) or $59/month (monthly), Professional at $99/month per user (annual), and Organization at $149/month per user (minimum 3 users, annual only). ### **What do users say about Apollo.io?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “Apollo makes it really easy to find accurate contact information and build targeted lead lists. I also like how seamlessly it integrates with email sequences, the sequences are a huge help for our business and they are easy to implement and track. Generally Customer support is very solid, going out of their way to help us set-up our business.” **Critical Review:** “Apollo.io changed their UI and added more limitations to the free tier. Now, you need 1 credit to save a verified email contact to your list, and the same goes for phone numbers. The free plan is now useless compared to what it used to be.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Apollo.io provides email support, live chat, and phone support for higher tiers. The platform offers comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and regular webinars. Users consistently praise the responsive support team who “go out of their way to help” with setup and issues. ## **FullContact** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link FullContact specializes in identity resolution, unifying customer data across email, social media, phone, and other touchpoints into single profiles. The platform enriches contacts with detailed demographic, social, and behavioral insights while maintaining enterprise-grade privacy compliance. ### **Highlights of FullContact** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Identity resolution unifying profiles across channels - Cross-channel engagement capabilities - 700+ behavioral insights with 85% match rates - Built-in GDPR and CCPA compliance ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **True identity resolution:** FullContact excels at connecting fragmented data across channels. You get a real 360-degree customer view by unifying scattered information. - **Deep enrichment data:** The platform provides extensive demographic, social, and behavioral insights. These details help personalize every customer interaction. - **Enterprise-ready features:** Robust privacy tools, enterprise security, and extensive CRM integrations make FullContact suitable for large organizations with strict requirements. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Complex pricing maze:** Users call the pricing structure overly complicated. Salespeople push expensive packages that quickly exceed small business budgets. - **Mobile app problems:** The Android app has bugs. Contact synchronization fails. The interface needs constant refreshing to work properly. - **Support struggles:** Support responds but rarely resolves issues. Some users report weeks of back-and-forth without fixing technical problems. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, FullContact starts at $500/month for Basic (small businesses), $2,000/month for Premium (medium businesses), and $10,000+/month for Enterprise. Pay-as-you-go starts at $99/month. Custom enterprise pricing available. ### **What do users say about FullContact?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “Using FullContact Enrich API, we can get a better picture of a person using their email address. We can get a person’s name, age, gender, city, country, job and a lot more details using the API. This data can be helpful in finding and qualifying leads. I’d highly recommend FullContact to anyone, whether through our platform or by their own integration.” **Critical Review:** “I would avoid this software at all costs. It has wasted time, energy and money for my business and has been detrimental to our sales efforts. When I needed access to our FullContact list from my personal laptop, it automatically synced my personal Google & iCloud contacts as well as personal bank details without permission. FullContact should not sync anything without permission.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link FullContact offers email support, dedicated account management for higher tiers, and phone support for enterprise customers. The company provides a knowledge base, community forums, and extensive documentation. User reviews show mixed experiences with response times and issue resolution. ## [**Snov.io**](http://snov.io/) ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Snov.io combines email finding, verification, and multichannel outreach including LinkedIn automation in one platform. The tool serves B2B teams needing lead generation, email marketing, and sales automation with built-in CRM functionality to manage the entire process. ### **Highlights of Snov.io** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Multichannel outreach with email and LinkedIn automation - Built-in email warm-up for better deliverability - 24/7 chat support with responsive team - Affordable pricing starting at $39/month ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **All-in-one simplicity:** Snov.io combines email finding, verification, campaigns, LinkedIn automation, and CRM. One subscription replaces multiple tools and streamlines workflows. - **Deliverability focus:** Built-in verification, warm-up tools, and deliverability checks maintain sender reputation. Your bounce rates drop while inbox placement improves. - **Support that cares:** Users consistently praise the 24/7 chat support. Quick responses, helpful team members, extensive blog content, and regular training webinars keep customers successful. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Credit math headaches:** Different actions consume varying credits. Most teams pay 2-3x the base plan once LinkedIn automation and actual credit needs factor in. - **LinkedIn costs extra:** LinkedIn slots cost $69/month each. Multichannel outreach gets expensive fast when you add these required extras. - **Accuracy varies:** Users report inconsistent email finding and verification. The platform sometimes misses obviously invalid addresses that should get caught. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Snov.io offers: Free trial with 50 credits and 100 recipients, Starter at $39/month (1,000 credits, 5,000 recipients), Pro at $99/month (5,000 credits, 10,000 recipients). Higher tiers available. LinkedIn automation costs extra $69/month per slot. ### **What do users say about Snov.io?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “What I like best about Snov.io is how clean and easy it is to use. The interface is super modern, so you’re not stuck digging through cluttered menus or outdated layouts—it just feels smooth. Throughout my time using Snov.io, the customer support team was prompt and helpful. Many users have shared their positive experiences with Snov.io, especially praising its easy-to-use interface, accurate email finding, and time-saving automation.” **Critical Review:** “During our month-long test, Snov.io consistently underperformed. The email finder failed one-third of the time. The verification missed obvious bad emails. And don’t get me started on their customer support. Snov.io had potential. Some features worked decently. The interface wasn’t terrible. The pricing seemed reasonable. It just wasn’t reliable enough for serious cold outreach.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Snov.io provides 24/7 live chat support and email support at help@snov.io. The platform offers educational resources including a regularly updated blog, webinars, and training sessions. Multiple contact options exist for partnerships and data protection inquiries. ## **Lusha** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Lusha provides B2B contact data through an easy-to-use platform that delivers email addresses, phone numbers, and company information. Known for simplicity, browser extension functionality, and CRM integrations, it’s particularly popular with sales development teams. ### **Highlights of Lusha** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - High-quality verified emails and direct phone numbers - Chrome extension for instant LinkedIn prospecting - Simple interface with minimal learning curve - Trusted by 1.5+ million users ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Start immediately:** Lusha’s intuitive interface needs no training. Sales teams begin using the platform instantly without extensive onboarding sessions. - **Direct browser access:** The platform works seamlessly in browsers and integrates with popular CRMs. Enrich leads in clicks without switching tools. - **Compliance first:** Lusha emphasizes data privacy and GDPR compliance. Perfect for businesses in regulated industries or international markets. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Credit limits hurt:** The Pro plan provides only 250 credits (about 40 leads monthly). Active sales teams burn through credits quickly. - **Costs escalate fast:** Entry pricing looks reasonable. But teams needing more credits, API access, or advanced integrations face significant price jumps. - **Features locked away:** Salesforce integration only comes with the top-tier Scale plan. Smaller teams on budget plans miss key functionality. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Lusha offers: Free plan with 40 credits monthly, Pro at $29/month per user (annual) or $39/month (monthly) with 250 annual credits, Premium at $51/month per user (annual) or $69.90/month (monthly) with 600 annual credits. Scale plan has custom pricing. ### **What do users say about Lusha?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “Lusha is one of the easiest data enrichment tools to use. It’s especially helpful for sales teams and marketers who want fast, accurate contact data without the complexity of a large platform. Lusha works directly in your browser, on LinkedIn, or inside your CRM so you can enrich leads and contacts in just a few clicks. It’s simple, reliable, and built for teams that move fast.” **Critical Review:** “The Pro plan might not be ideal for larger companies. The Premium and Scale plans offer more credits for those who need them. Advanced features like technographic filters and CRM integration can only be found in the Scale plan. Some users find the guides easy to follow, while others want more in-depth training.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Lusha offers email support through their contact form, plus a help center with documentation organized by topics. Phone support comes with higher-tier plans. The company provides training materials, video tutorials, and maintains a community forum for best practices. ## **ZoomInfo API** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link ZoomInfo API delivers enterprise-grade access to one of the world’s largest B2B databases, providing comprehensive search and enrichment for organizations with serious data needs. The platform combines real-time updates with advanced filtering to help sales teams identify and connect with ideal prospects. ### **Highlights of ZoomInfo API** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - 150M+ contact profiles and 20M+ companies - Daily data refreshes with bulk enrichment - Customizable schemas and webhooks - SOC 2 Type II compliance ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Massive data coverage:** ZoomInfo maintains comprehensive global reach for prospecting and enrichment. Over 150 million contacts ensure you find who you need. - **Real-time freshness:** Daily refresh and change alerts maintain database quality. Your bounce rates drop significantly compared to monthly-updated competitors. - **Enterprise security:** SOC 2 Type II compliance, SSO, and role-based access control protect sensitive data while meeting corporate requirements. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Budget killer:** Pricing starts above $10,000 yearly. Small businesses simply can’t afford entry-level access to **data enrichment APIs** at this price point. - **Long-term lock-in:** Annual commitments and high minimums reduce flexibility. You’re tied into contracts regardless of changing needs. - **Complex setup:** Initial configuration and schema mapping require dedicated technical resources. Deployment timelines stretch longer than expected. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, ZoomInfo API plans start at $12,000/year for basic API access with minimum 50,000 records. Enterprise and custom tiers available upon request. ### **What do users say about ZoomInfo API?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “ZoomInfo’s API allowed us to enrich our entire CRM database in under a week. The data quality and coverage are unmatched, which drastically improved our campaign performance.” **Critical Review:** “The onboarding process was painful—schema mapping took weeks, and hidden fees drove our annual spend up by 20% after the first renewal.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link ZoomInfo offers dedicated account management for API customers, 24/7 email and phone support, detailed developer documentation, sandbox environments, and regular data quality webinars. ## **Apollo.io Pro** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Apollo.io Pro extends the free Apollo API with higher limits, advanced fields, and priority support. The platform enhances prospecting by providing deeper firmographic, technographic, and intent data for teams needing scale. ### **Highlights of Apollo.io Pro** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Increased monthly credit quotas - 70+ additional data points including tech stack - Priority support with 4-hour SLAs - 250,000 API credits monthly ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Advanced data fields:** Access tech stack details and buyer intent signals. These extra 70 data points power more targeted outbound campaigns. - **Scale-ready throughput:** Pro tier offers up to 250,000 API credits monthly. Large-scale enrichment jobs run smoothly without hitting limits. - **Priority treatment:** Pro customers receive 4-hour response SLAs and guided onboarding. Your issues get resolved faster than standard users. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Credit cost confusion:** Variable credit costs per endpoint make monthly spend unpredictable. Budget forecasting becomes nearly impossible without detailed monitoring. - **Rate limit walls:** Despite higher quotas, strict per-second limits require careful batching. Your integration needs complex logic to avoid throttling. - **Surprise overages:** Exceeding credits triggers automatic premium-rate billing. Teams often face unexpected $5,000+ charges after busy months. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Apollo.io Pro API starts at $1,000/month for 100,000 credits. Additional credit bundles available at $0.01 per credit. ### **What do users say about Apollo.io Pro?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “Upgrading to Pro unlocked technographic insights that directly contributed to a 30% increase in qualified pipeline. The API is rock-solid.” **Critical Review:** “The shifting credit costs per endpoint make budgeting impossible. We had a surprise $5,000 overage charge after a busy month.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Apollo Pro customers receive dedicated onboarding, priority email and chat support, private Slack channel access, and quarterly API health reviews. ## **People Data Labs** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link People Data Labs offers developer-focused **data enrichment APIs** with access to over 3 billion person profiles and extensive company data. The service emphasizes accuracy and compliance while offering flexible pricing that scales with usage. ### **Highlights of People Data Labs** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - 3 billion profiles and 200 million companies - Custom streaming API for real-time updates - GDPR and CCPA compliant - Flexible batch and streaming modes ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Massive global dataset:** One of the largest person graphs available delivers high match rates. Rich attribute depth covers diverse geographic markets. - **Flexible delivery options:** Supports both synchronous batch lookups and asynchronous streams. Your use case determines the best approach. - **Transparent pricing:** Per-record pricing clearly defined by endpoint and depth. No hidden fees or surprise charges appear. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Stale data risk:** Some records update quarterly only. Fast-moving contacts may have outdated information when you need accuracy. - **Limited support tiers:** Lower plans rely on community support. Only higher tiers include SLAs, leaving smaller customers waiting. - **Complex pricing matrix:** Multiple endpoints with different costs require careful planning. Mapping endpoints to use cases takes time. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, PDL charges $0.004 per enriched person record. Volume discounts apply for commitments over 1 million records monthly. ### **What do users say about People Data Labs?** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link **Positive Review:** “PDL’s depth of data returned firmographic and technographic attributes I couldn’t get anywhere else. Integration was seamless.” **Critical Review:** “Support was slow on our startup plan—tickets took days to resolve and we lacked SLA guarantees, which hindered our go-live timeline.” ### **Support** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link People Data Labs offers email support for all customers, premium SLAs for paid plans, detailed API documentation, code samples, and monthly product webinars. ## **Proxycurl** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link Proxycurl provides real-time LinkedIn and company data through API endpoints that deliver fresh profiles in under 3 seconds. The platform scrapes data live rather than using cached databases, ensuring current information for businesses needing accuracy. ### **Highlights of Proxycurl** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - Real-time scraping across LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase - Automatic HTML normalization to JSON - Simple RESTful endpoints - Data less than 29 days old ### **Pros** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Developer-friendly design:** Well-documented endpoints and SDKs in multiple languages speed integration. Clear documentation makes implementation straightforward. - **Wide source coverage:** Scrapes multiple public sources for comprehensive profiles. You get complete professional data from various platforms. - **Affordable entry:** Starter plan at $49/month makes it accessible. Small teams can test without major commitment. ### **Cons** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link - **Legal gray areas:** Web scraping raises compliance questions. You must manage terms-of-service risks carefully in regulated industries. - **Blocking issues:** Aggressive scraping triggers IP blocks. Your integration needs extensive retry logic to handle failures. - **Data gaps exist:** Scraped data lacks depth compared to partner databases. Certain regions show incomplete coverage. ### **Pricing** ![](https://coefficient.io/wp-content/themes/coefficient/assets/images/coeff-icons/link-icon.svg)Click to copy link As of February 2025, Proxycurl pricing: $49/month for 1,000 API calls, $199/month for 10,000 calls. web.markdown:
TL;DR

We tested 15 B2B data enrichment providers on real-world accuracy, coverage, and pricing. [Waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/glossary/waterfall-enrichment) tools like Cleanlist (98% email accuracy) outperform single-database providers like ZoomInfo (85%) and Apollo (80%) - often at a fraction of the cost.

If you're asking "what is [data enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/glossary/data-enrichment)" and why it matters, the short answer: it's the process of enhancing your existing B2B records with verified emails, phone numbers, firmographics, and more from external sources. It's table stakes now. Every sales and marketing team needs accurate contact data to hit their numbers, and the best data enrichment tools make the difference between 80% and 98% deliverability.

But the market is crowded. Over 50 vendors sell some version of "B2B data," and if you're searching for [alternatives to Clearbit](https://www.cleanlist.ai/alternatives/clearbit) or CRM data cleaning tools, the choices are overwhelming. Most providers use the same underlying sources, slap a different UI on top, and charge wildly different prices for similar results.

> “Organizations with high-quality B2B data are 2.5x more likely to exceed revenue targets — yet 44% of companies still rely on a single data provider.”

We tested and ranked 15 providers based on five criteria that actually matter: accuracy, coverage, pricing transparency, integrations, and ease of use. No vendor paid for placement. No affiliate links.

## [How We Ranked These Providers](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#how-we-ranked-these-providers)

Each tool was evaluated across five weighted categories:

- **Accuracy (30%)**: Email deliverability rates and phone connection rates from real-world testing
- **Coverage (25%)**: Database size, fill rates for key fields (email, phone, title, company data)
- **Pricing (20%)**: Cost per enrichment, pricing transparency, minimum commitments
- **Integrations (15%)**: CRM connectors, API quality, workflow compatibility
- **Ease of use (10%)**: Time to value, interface quality, learning curve

We ran 1,000 contact enrichments through each platform and measured actual deliverability - not the accuracy numbers vendors claim on their websites.

$3.1T

estimated annual cost of poor data quality to the US economy

Bad data affects every downstream process — from email deliverability to pipeline forecasting and revenue attribution.

[Source: IBM, Cost of Poor Data Quality](https://www.ibm.com/thought-leadership/institute-business-value/en-us/report/data-quality)

## [Which Data Enrichment Providers Made the Top 5?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#which-data-enrichment-providers-made-the-top-5)

| Rank | Provider | Approach | Email Accuracy | Pricing | Best For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cleanlist | Waterfall (15+ sources) | 98% | Credit-based, flexible | Accuracy-first teams |
| 2 | ZoomInfo | Single database | 85% | $15K+/year | Enterprise + intent data |
| 3 | Apollo | Single database | 80% | $59-149/user/mo | SMB all-in-one |
| 4 | Cognism | Single database | 90% | Custom, ~$8-15K/yr | European data + compliance |
| 5 | Clearbit | API-first | 85% | Custom, HubSpot-integrated | Product-led growth teams |

## [Quick Verdict: Best Data Enrichment Tool by Use Case](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#quick-verdict-best-data-enrichment-tool-by-use-case)

- **Best for email accuracy**: Cleanlist — 98% deliverability from 15+ waterfall sources, every email verified in real-time
- **Best for enterprise + intent data**: ZoomInfo — largest proprietary database (300M+ contacts) with built-in intent signals
- **Best for startups on a budget**: Apollo — data + outreach in one tool starting at $59/user/month with a free tier
- **Best for European data**: Cognism — deepest EMEA coverage with GDPR compliance built in
- **Best for HubSpot teams**: Clearbit (Breeze Intelligence) — native HubSpot enrichment with website visitor identification
- **Best for waterfall enrichment**: Cleanlist — queries 15+ providers per lookup so no single source gap kills your coverage
- **Best for CRM data cleaning**: Cleanlist — automated deduplication, normalization, and multi-source verification
- **Best free tier**: Apollo — 100 credits/month free with email sequences included
- **Best for developers**: People Data Labs — raw API access to 1.5B+ records with self-serve pricing from $0.01/record
- **Best for direct dials**: Lusha — fast Chrome extension with strong phone number coverage

* * *

## [1\. Cleanlist](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#1-cleanlist)

**Best for**: Teams that need verified, accurate data without overpaying

Cleanlist doesn't maintain a single database. Instead, it uses [waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-01-22-what-is-waterfall-enrichment) to query 15+ premium data sources for every lookup. If Provider 1 doesn't have the email, it tries Provider 2, then Provider 3 - up to 15+ sources deep.

The result: higher fill rates than any single-source tool, with every email verified before it's returned.

**What sets it apart**:

- **Waterfall enrichment**: 15+ data sources queried per lookup. No single point of failure for coverage gaps.
- **98% email accuracy**: Every email is verified in real-time. Not periodically - on every single lookup.
- **[People Search](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/people-search)**: Access 500M+ professional profiles. Search by natural language or 30+ filters to build targeted lead lists from scratch.
- **[ICP Scoring](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/icp-scoring)**: Score every lead against your Ideal Customer Profile automatically.
- **Smart Agents**: Normalize job titles, format phone numbers, and transform messy data without manual cleanup.
- **Credit-based pricing**: Pay for what you use. No annual contracts required. No per-seat fees.

**Strengths**:

- Highest accuracy in our testing (98% email deliverability)
- Flexible pricing works for teams of 1 or 100
- People Search lets you build lists from zero - no existing data needed
- Data transformation features clean records automatically

**Weaknesses**:

- No built-in outreach or email sequences
- No intent data signals
- Newer brand with less market recognition than ZoomInfo

**Pricing**: Credit-based. Email-only enrichment starts at 1 credit. Full enrichment (email + phone + firmographics) costs 11 credits. People Search exports cost 20 credits per 100 contacts. Volume discounts available. [See pricing](https://www.cleanlist.ai/pricing).

**Best for**: RevOps teams, agencies, and anyone who's tired of bounced emails and inaccurate phone numbers. Especially strong for teams that need to [build lead lists from scratch](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/people-search) or clean existing CRM data.

See Why Cleanlist Ranks #1

98% email accuracy from 15+ data sources. No annual contracts. Start with 30 free credits.

[Try Cleanlist Free →](https://app.cleanlist.ai/auth/register?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked&utm_content=blog_inline_cta)

* * *

## [2\. ZoomInfo](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#2-zoominfo)

**Best for**: Enterprise companies that need intent data and a single vendor

ZoomInfo is the market leader for a reason. It has the largest proprietary B2B database, the most mature intent data product, and the brand recognition that makes procurement teams comfortable.

But that comes with enterprise pricing and enterprise complexity.

**Strengths**:

- 300M+ contacts, 100M+ company profiles - the largest proprietary database
- Intent data that shows which companies are actively researching your category
- Full platform: sales engagement, conversation intelligence, website visitor identification
- Enterprise-grade security, SSO, compliance features

**Weaknesses**:

- Pricing starts at $15K/year and scales quickly to $40K+
- Annual contracts with auto-renewal make exiting painful
- Single-source database means unavoidable [data decay](https://www.cleanlist.ai/glossary/data-decay) and gaps
- Opaque pricing requires talking to sales before budgeting

**Pricing**: SalesOS Professional starts ~$15,000/year. Advanced ~$25,000/year. Elite (with intent) ~$40,000+/year. Per-seat fees apply.

**Best for**: Enterprise organizations with budget, teams that need intent signals, companies that want everything from one vendor. If ZoomInfo's pricing is out of reach, see our breakdown of the [best ZoomInfo alternatives](https://www.cleanlist.ai/alternatives/zoominfo) or a direct [Cleanlist vs ZoomInfo comparison](https://www.cleanlist.ai/compare/cleanlist-vs-zoominfo). For a full cost breakdown, read our [ZoomInfo pricing guide](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-19-zoominfo-pricing-guide).

* * *

## [3\. Apollo](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#3-apollo)

**Best for**: Startups and SMBs wanting data + outreach in one tool

Apollo grew fast by combining a large contact database with email sequences, a dialer, and a Chrome extension - all at a price point startups can afford. It's the "good enough at everything" option.

**Strengths**:

- Transparent pricing at $59-149/user/month - accessible for small teams
- All-in-one: data + sequences + dialer, no need to integrate multiple tools
- Free tier with 100 credits/month to test before committing
- Clean interface with fast time to value

**Weaknesses**:

- Lower email accuracy (~80%) leads to higher bounce rates
- Limited direct dial phone coverage compared to ZoomInfo or Cleanlist
- Single-source database with the same gap problems as ZoomInfo
- Platform optimizes for outreach features; [data quality](https://www.cleanlist.ai/glossary/data-quality) is secondary

**Pricing**: Free (100 credits/month), Basic $59/user/month, Professional $99/user/month, Organization $149/user/month.

**Best for**: Early-stage teams with limited budget who want one tool for prospecting and outreach. See how Apollo stacks up in our [Cleanlist vs Apollo comparison](https://www.cleanlist.ai/compare/cleanlist-vs-apollo), browse [Apollo alternatives](https://www.cleanlist.ai/alternatives/apollo), or read our [Apollo pricing guide](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-19-apollo-pricing-guide).

* * *

## [4\. Cognism](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#4-cognism)

**Best for**: European data and GDPR compliance

Cognism is the strongest option for teams selling into EMEA markets. Its database has deeper European coverage than any US-based competitor, and GDPR compliance is built into the product - not bolted on.

**Strengths**:

- Best European data coverage in the market
- GDPR-compliant by design, with consent-based data collection
- Phone-verified mobile numbers (Diamond Data) for direct dials
- Intent data through Bombora partnership

**Weaknesses**:

- Smaller US database than ZoomInfo or Apollo
- Custom pricing that's still expensive (typically $8-15K/year)
- Limited data transformation or enrichment depth beyond contact info

**Pricing**: Custom. Typically 40-60% less than ZoomInfo, but still enterprise-priced at $8-15K/year.

**Best for**: Companies selling into European markets where GDPR compliance is non-negotiable. For a full cost breakdown, read our [Cognism pricing guide](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-19-cognism-pricing-guide).

* * *

## [5\. Clearbit (now Breeze Intelligence)](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#5-clearbit-now-breeze-intelligence)

**Best for**: HubSpot-native teams and product-led growth companies

Clearbit was the original API-first enrichment tool. After being acquired by HubSpot in 2023, it's now deeply integrated into the HubSpot ecosystem as Breeze Intelligence.

**Strengths**:

- Native HubSpot integration - enrichment happens inside your CRM automatically
- Strong company data and firmographics
- Real-time enrichment API for product-led use cases (form shortening, lead routing)
- Website visitor identification (Reveal)

**Weaknesses**:

- Increasingly HubSpot-dependent - less useful if you're on Salesforce
- Limited phone data coverage
- Post-acquisition product direction is uncertain
- Less competitive on standalone enrichment since the HubSpot merger

## [What Do Data Enrichment Companies Actually Do?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-do-data-enrichment-companies-actually-do)

Data enrichment companies take your existing contact or account records and fill in the gaps — appending verified emails, direct phone numbers, job titles, company firmographics, technographics, and more from external databases. Some vendors maintain a single proprietary database (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Lusha), while others aggregate data from multiple providers using [waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/waterfall-enrichment) for higher coverage and accuracy.

The best data enrichment vendors differentiate on three dimensions: **data accuracy** (what percentage of returned emails actually deliver), **coverage breadth** (how many fields they can fill and how many contacts they cover), and **pricing model** (per-seat, per-credit, or platform fee). The gap between claimed accuracy and real-world accuracy is often 15-20 percentage points — which is why we ran actual deliverability tests for every provider on this list.

of B2B data goes stale every year

People change jobs, companies get acquired, and emails become invalid — making enrichment an ongoing process, not a one-time project.

[Source: Gartner, Data Quality Market Survey](https://www.gartner.com/en/sales/topics/data-quality)

When evaluating data enrichment companies, ask for a trial enrichment on your own data rather than relying on vendor-provided sample sets. Match rates on curated demos rarely reflect what you'll see with your actual CRM records. For our latest hands-on comparison with accuracy benchmarks, see the [best data enrichment tools for 2026](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/best-data-enrichment-tools-2026).

## [How to Choose the Right Data Enrichment Vendor](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#how-to-choose-the-right-data-enrichment-vendor)

Enterprise budgets open up ZoomInfo and Cognism. Mid-market teams should look at Cleanlist, Apollo, or UpLead. Bootstrapped teams might start with Apollo's free tier or Snov.io. Use our [data enrichment ROI framework](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-02-data-enrichment-roi-framework) to calculate the right spend for your team.

### [3\. Do you need more than data?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#3-do-you-need-more-than-data)

If you need data + outreach in one tool, Apollo is the clear pick. If you need intent data, ZoomInfo. If you need accurate data to feed into your existing stack, Cleanlist.

## [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#frequently-asked-questions)

### [What is B2B data enrichment?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-is-b2b-data-enrichment)

Data enrichment is the process of enhancing your existing contact or company records with additional information - emails, phone numbers, job titles, company size, technographics, and more. It fills gaps in your CRM and keeps records current.

### [How much does data enrichment cost?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#how-much-does-data-enrichment-cost)

Pricing ranges from $0.01/record (raw API access via PDL) to $2+/record (ZoomInfo at lower volumes). Most mid-market tools cost $0.10-0.50 per enrichment. Cleanlist's credit-based model works out to roughly $0.15-0.30 per full enrichment. For a full breakdown, see our [data enrichment cost guide](https://www.cleanlist.ai/learn/how-much-does-data-enrichment-cost).

### [Can I use multiple enrichment providers?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#can-i-use-multiple-enrichment-providers)

Yes. Many teams layer providers - using one for initial prospecting and another for verification. Cleanlist's [waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/waterfall-enrichment) does this automatically across 15+ sources, eliminating the need to manage multiple subscriptions.

### [What's the difference between single-source and waterfall enrichment?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#whats-the-difference-between-single-source-and-waterfall-enrichment)

Single-source tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Lusha) maintain one database. If the contact isn't in their database, you get nothing. [Waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/waterfall-enrichment) queries multiple providers in sequence - if Source 1 misses, Source 2, 3, or 15 picks it up. Result: higher fill rates and better accuracy.

### [How often should I re-enrich my data?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#how-often-should-i-re-enrich-my-data)

B2B data decays at roughly 30% per year. Re-enrich active records quarterly and your full database at least twice a year. [Email verification](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/email-verification) should happen before every major campaign. Start with a [CRM data quality audit](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-02-how-to-audit-crm-data-quality) to identify which records need attention first.

### [What data do enrichment companies provide?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-data-do-enrichment-companies-provide)

Most B2B data enrichment companies provide contact-level data (email addresses, phone numbers, job titles, LinkedIn URLs) and company-level data (firmographics like employee count, revenue, industry, headquarters location). Some vendors also offer technographic data (what software a company uses), intent data (signals that a company is researching your category), and organizational charts. The depth varies significantly — tools like [Cleanlist](https://www.cleanlist.ai/pricing) return 50+ data points per record through multi-source enrichment, while simpler tools like Hunter.io only return email addresses.

### [How do I evaluate a data enrichment vendor?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#how-do-i-evaluate-a-data-enrichment-vendor)

Run a blind test. Upload 500-1,000 records from your actual CRM and compare fill rates, accuracy, and pricing across 2-3 vendors. Key metrics to track: email deliverability rate (not just "match rate"), phone connection rate (not just "coverage"), and data freshness (when were records last verified). Avoid relying on vendor-provided accuracy stats — they're almost always measured on curated datasets, not your data. Also check whether the vendor uses [waterfall enrichment](https://www.cleanlist.ai/product/waterfall-enrichment) (multiple sources) or a single database, since this directly affects coverage.

### [Is data enrichment a one-time process or ongoing?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#is-data-enrichment-a-one-time-process-or-ongoing)

Ongoing. B2B contact data decays at 2-3% per month — people change jobs, companies get acquired, phone numbers disconnect. A list that's 95% accurate today will be roughly 70% accurate in a year without re-enrichment. The best practice is to set up automated enrichment workflows that re-verify records on a schedule (quarterly minimum) and trigger re-enrichment when records show signs of decay, like email bounces or form resubmissions with updated details.

### [What are the best data enrichment tools in 2026?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-are-the-best-data-enrichment-tools-in-2026)

The top B2B data enrichment tools include Cleanlist, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit (now Breeze by HubSpot), Clay, Lusha, and Cognism. Cleanlist stands out with its waterfall enrichment approach and pay-per-result pricing, while ZoomInfo offers the largest database and Clay excels at workflow automation.

### [What are good alternatives to Clearbit?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-are-good-alternatives-to-clearbit)

Since Clearbit was acquired by HubSpot and rebranded as Breeze, many teams are exploring alternatives. Cleanlist offers similar enrichment capabilities with waterfall enrichment for higher accuracy. Other Clearbit alternatives include Apollo, Lusha, and Clay.

### [What are the best alternatives to Cognism?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-are-the-best-alternatives-to-cognism)

Top Cognism alternatives include Cleanlist, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and Lusha. Cleanlist differentiates with pay-per-result pricing (vs Cognism's annual contracts) and waterfall enrichment that queries 50+ data providers for better coverage, especially in non-European markets.

### [What are the best CRM data cleaning tools?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-are-the-best-crm-data-cleaning-tools)

The best CRM data cleaning tools include Cleanlist, which offers automated deduplication and enrichment through its waterfall approach, as well as ZoomInfo for enterprise teams and Insycle for HubSpot-native cleanup. Regular CRM hygiene prevents data decay that costs companies an estimated $15 million per year. Start with a [CRM data quality audit](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-03-02-how-to-audit-crm-data-quality) to benchmark where you stand.

### [What are cheaper alternatives to Clay?](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/15-best-b2b-data-enrichment-providers-in-2025-ranked\#what-are-cheaper-alternatives-to-clay)

Clay is powerful but expensive at scale due to per-credit pricing. Cleanlist offers similar waterfall enrichment capabilities at a fraction of the cost with pay-per-result pricing and no per-seat charges. Apollo and Lusha also provide more affordable enrichment options.

* * *

Data enrichment is foundational. Every downstream activity - outreach, scoring, routing, reporting - depends on having accurate records. Choose a provider that matches your accuracy needs, budget, and workflow. If you're also evaluating tools for prospecting and list building, see our [best sales prospecting tools](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/2026-02-15-best-sales-prospecting-tools) comparison. For a head-to-head breakdown of the three biggest names, read our [ZoomInfo vs Apollo vs Clearbit](https://www.cleanlist.ai/blog/zoominfo-apollo-clearbit-data-provider-comparison-2026) deep dive. And if accuracy is what matters most, [start with Cleanlist](https://www.cleanlist.ai/pricing).

Turn anonymous website visitors into pipeline

Enhance web engagement, targeting, and pipeline conversion.

Used by

![General Catalyst Logo](https://www.peopledatalabs.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fv2gxjkym%2Fproduction%2Fec9ca0133b19d1dafef88a87fb0db030ed83056c-73x17.svg&w=256&q=75)

Benefits

Gain visibility into website traffic

Match IP addresses to specific companies, giving you valuable insights into potential leads and target accounts with buying intent.

Build highly targeted lists

Identify the companies visiting your website in order to prioritize leads and customize their outreach by filling in the gaps in your sales pipeline.

Deliver personalized experiences that convert

Create experiences that resonate with your visitors, increasing engagement, and driving higher conversion rates.

Improve your sales process

Understand what companies are visiting your website to inform your sales strategy and improve conversion rates.

How it works

Provide an IP address

Start with a list of IP addresses from your website traffic. Call the API with an IP address in IPv4 or IPv6 format.

Receive enriched data

PDL provides company, person, and IP location information along with related metadata (mobile or using hosting, proxy, Tor, VPN, relay or other service).

Power your marketing & sales strategies

Focus on high-value website visitors and effectively engage with them during their stage of the buyer's journey. Use the Person Search API, to find key decision-makers within those companies.

[The Bottomline](https://nubela.co/blog/best-data-enrichment-apis/#the-bottomline) What's worse than inaccurate data? Incomplete data. Raw data lacks the depth and context necessary to be truly useful. This is where data enrichment comes in to help fill the gaps. ## What is data enrichment? Data enrichment involves enhancing raw data by adding valuable information from external sources. Imagine having a list of customer names and email addresses. Data enrichment can augment this list with details like job titles, company names, social media profiles, and other relevant information. This enriched data offers a more complete view of your prospects/customers, allowing you to do much more in many different aspects. ### Understanding APIs To efficiently perform data enrichment, businesses often use [APIs](https://nubela.co/proxycurl/?ref=nubela.co). An API, or Application Programming Interface, is like a translator that allows different software applications to communicate with each other. One system requests data or services from another system and receive a response, in a structured way. ### How data enrichment APIs work [Data enrichment APIs](https://nubela.co/proxycurl/?ref=nubela.co) are specialized tools that add external information to your exisiting datasets programmatically. Instead of manually searching for and inputting additional data, these APIs automate the process. For example, if you have a customer's name and email address, a data enrichment API can automatically retrieve and add their job title, company details, and social media profiles to your database. It saves time, ensures accuracy by reducing manual entry errors, keeps information up-to-date with real-time updates, and handles large volumes of data efficiently. ## Benefits of Data enrichment APIs Data enrichment APIs have a wide range of applications, including: ### Improved customer insights Enriched data helps create detailed customer profiles, enabling personalized marketing and enhanced customer experiences.
